definitions.short: to swallow greedily ; causatively, to feed
definitions.full: H3938. laat [ לָעַט ] verb swallow (greedily) (Late Hebrew id. , Hiph`il stuff cattle with food; Syriac jaw ; compare Arabic speak confusedly, utter indistinct sounds); — only Hiph`il Imperative masculine singular suffix causat, הַלְעִיטֵנִי Gen 25:30 (J) let me swallow , followed by מִן of thing.

occurrences.englishText: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.* “Edom” means “red”.
